title: Mistral configurations recognize image input
summary:
Mistral’s image-input metadata got corrected, the Special Bee request link got useful, and outdated supporter references got pruned.

Five Scaleway-backed Mistral configurations now advertise vision support instead of text-only input, so clients can use the models’ existing image capabilities.

The API docs’ Special Bee Request link now opens a new GitHub issue with the request template, rather than the template’s YAML file.

LLMPlayground.net was removed from the website supporter list, README references, and architecture diagram. The diagram no longer identifies it as a custom FLUX model host.
